question: Where can I get a list of battery storage (BESS) installations in operation in Australia, with location, power (MW), energy (MWh), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: No single official national list exists. For the NEM (QLD, NSW/ACT, VIC, SA, TAS) AEMO's quarterly NEM Generation Information xlsx lists each battery unit with status, MW AC, MWh and owner (58 units across 'In Service' and 'In Commissioning', Oct 2026); NEMWEB MMS tables add registered participant, station address and registration dates. Neither gives coordinates and commissioning dates are mostly blank. For WA's WEM, AEMO's daily facilities CSV gives only code, participant and System Size (combined import and export rating). Open Electricity (non-official, CC BY-NC) covers NEM+WEM with coordinates, MW, MWh, owner and start date. NT/off-grid not verified.
main_caveats: Registration is not operation: MMS START_DATE and 'COMMISSIONED' mark registration (often the 2024 IESS re-registration); GI 'In Service' needs AEMO sign-off after commissioning tests.
GI status can lag: Waratah Super Battery (WTAHB1) is 'Committed' in the Oct 2026 release while MMS SCADA shows it discharging up to 556.8 MW in Oct 2026.
WEM 'System Size' adds withdrawal to export capacity: KWINANA_ESR1 System Size 200 vs ~100 MW peak in Oct 2026 SCADA; use a documented export rating. SCADA shows observed output only.
GI and MMS give MW and MWh per generating unit (DUID row); a site or hybrid spans several rows and 'Max Site Capacity (AC)' caps the site.
Official files name owner, MSATS custodian or registered participant, not an operator; they can differ (MREHA3: owner Equis SPV, participant SEC Energy).
Open Electricity is non-official, CC BY-NC 4.0 and excludes AI training/grounding from its standard licence; its MW, MWh and dates can differ from AEMO.
answer.confidence_reason: NEM and WEM official files were downloaded and cross-checked; NT/off-grid, AER and DCCEEW pages could not be opened (403/timeouts) and Overpass was unavailable.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o gi.xlsx 'https://www.aemo.com.au/-/media/files/electricity/nem/planning_and_forecasting/generation_information/2026/nem-generation-information-oct-2026.xlsx?rev=e4625386b864409786cd79986dd0ac04&sc_lang=en'  # sheet 'Generator Information', header row 4; Technology Type='Battery Storage'; Commitment Status in ('In Service','In Commissioning')
how_to_use.example_result: Hornsdale Power Reserve Unit 1 | HPRG1 | DUID HPR1 | SA1 | In Service | 100 MW AC | 117 MWh | Site Owner Hornsdale Power Reserve Pty Ltd | Custodian HORNSPR (2nd row HPRG EXP: 50 MW, 61.3 MWh)
steps: Download the latest 'NEM <Month> <Year> Generation Information' xlsx: the file URL with its ?rev= query answered 200 to curl; the landing page and the URL without ?rev= answered 403.
Sheet 'Generator Information': rows 1-3 are notes, row 4 is the header (76 columns).
Filter Technology Type == 'Battery Storage'; keep Commitment Status 'In Service' (55 rows) and optionally 'In Commissioning' (3 rows): 58 rows on 54 sites in Oct 2026.
Group by AEMO Survey ID (site); use Max Site Capacity (AC) as the site cap of hybrids.
Join DUID to NEMWEB MMS tables for locality and registered participant; join AEMO KCI ID to the KCI datafile ('Site Location Description', free text; 29 of 58 rows have a KCI ID).
For an in-service date use the 'Change Log' sheet (status change rows with Publication Date) or the FCUD of older releases (July 2024: FCUD filled for 19 of 24 in-service battery rows).
reading_traps: No coordinates or address: the only location field is the NEM region; NSW1 includes ACT sites (e.g. Capital Battery).
Status lags reality: Waratah Super Battery (WTAHB1) is 'Committed' in Oct 2026 while MMS SCADA shows it dispatching up to 556.8 MW in Oct 2026.
Full Commercial Use Date is empty for 44 of 58 operating battery rows and is indicative (NESBESS1 2026-07-31 while still 'In Commissioning').
Eraring ERB01 has a 460 MW/1073 MWh row and a 0 MW/700 MWh row (energy-only augmentation) under one DUID.
Hybrid sites list each technology as a separate unit sharing Max Site Capacity (e.g. Adelaide Desalination Plant battery 6.3 MW on a 26 MW site).
Change Log can repeat a transition (ORABESS1 'In Commissioning To In Service' on 2026-07-24 and again 2026-10-30).

problems: Landing page and file URL without ?rev= return HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) to automated clients.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o dudetail.zip 'https://nemweb.com.au/Data_Archive/Wholesale_Electricity/MMSDM/2026/MMSDM_2026_10/MMSDM_Historical_Data_SQLLoader/DATA/PUBLIC_ARCHIVE%23DUDETAIL%23FILE01%23202610010000.zip'  # unzip; rows 'D'; DISPATCHTYPE=='BIDIRECTIONAL'; latest EFFECTIVEDATE/VERSIONNO per DUID
how_to_use.example_result: DUID BLYTHB1, EFFECTIVEDATE 2024/08/20, REGISTEREDCAPACITY 281, MAXCAPACITY 200, MAXSTORAGECAPACITY 400; STATION BLYTHB CITY Blyth STATE SA; DUDETAILSUMMARY PARTICIPANTID BLYTHBAT
steps: In MMSDM_YYYY_MM/MMSDM_Historical_Data_SQLLoader/DATA/ download PUBLIC_ARCHIVE#DUDETAIL, #DUDETAILSUMMARY, #STATION, #STATIONOPERATINGSTATUS zips ('#' encoded as %23).
Each CSV has 'C' (comment), 'I' (header) and 'D' (data) rows; use the 'I' row as header.
DUDETAIL is versioned: keep max (EFFECTIVEDATE, VERSIONNO) per DUID; filter DISPATCHTYPE == 'BIDIRECTIONAL' (70 DUIDs).
DUDETAILSUMMARY rows with END_DATE in the future give current PARTICIPANTID/STATIONID/REGIONID; earliest START_DATE per DUID is the BDU registration.
Join STATIONID to STATION for address/locality/postcode and DUID to GI for status and owner.
For pre-2024 batteries look for GENERATOR/LOAD DUIDs on the same STATIONID (e.g. HPRG1/HPRL1 from 2017/11/14 at HORNSDPR).
For first output, scan PUBLIC_ARCHIVE#DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA (~30-34 MB per month) for the first |SCADAVALUE| > 0 of the DUID.
Join PARTICIPANTID to PUBLIC_ARCHIVE#PARTICIPANT for the participant's legal name (e.g. KESSB1 -> Shell Energy Retail Pty Ltd).
reading_traps: BDU START_DATE is mostly the mid-2024 IESS re-registration: Hornsdale HPR1 starts 2024/09/12, HPRG1 2017/11/14.
STATIONOPERATINGSTATUS 'COMMISSIONED' is set at registration: WTAHBESS 'COMMISSIONED' since 2024/09/03 while GI Oct 2026 says 'Committed'.
MAXSTORAGECAPACITY differs from GI MWh by >10% for 10 of 64 matched DUIDs (e.g. ADPBA1 6 vs 12.6; LIMBESS1 536 vs 400).
70 BIDIRECTIONAL DUIDs vs 58 operating GI rows: 6 DUIDs (BLUEGB1, MOORABS1, PLBESS1, STABESS1, TRGBESS1, WOORB1) are not in the Oct 2026 GI.
STATION address can be postal (e.g. Callide 'PO BOX 392'); treat as locality unless it names a road or lot.
SCADA right after registration can exceed nameplate: NESBESS1 reached 191.7 MW on 2026-02-18 for a 100 MW unit.

if_unstructured.summary: Official structured data cover the NEM (no coordinates, few commissioning dates) and WA's SWIS (no MWh, location or dates). Missing pieces come from AEMO's release archive and Change Log and from WA government pages and reports; NT/off-grid documents could not be opened.
recipe: NEM list: take GI 'Generator Information' rows with Technology Type 'Battery Storage' and Commitment Status 'In Service' (+ 'In Commissioning'); join DUID to MMS DUDETAIL (latest version), DUDETAILSUMMARY, STATION and PARTICIPANT (64 of 70 bidirectional DUIDs match GI).

NEM in-service date: in the GI 'Change Log' find 'Unit Status Updated From In Commissioning To In Service' (e.g. LDBESS1 in the 2026-10-30 release); for units in service before 2025 read FCUD in older releases (July 2024: 19 of 24 in-service battery rows filled).

Evidence case NESBESS1 (New England Solar Farm BESS): Change Log 2026-01-30 'From Anticipated to Committed*'; MMS registration 2026-02-18 (START_DATE, station 'COMMISSIONED'); first SCADA output 2026-02-18 05:50 (1.76 MW); 2026-04-30 'Committed* To In Commissioning' (hold point >=30%); Oct 2026 SCADA +/-100 MW but still 'In Commissioning' with FCUD moved to 2026-07-31.
NEM location: STATION address/locality (road or lot + locality + postcode), KCI 'Site Location Description' via AEMO KCI ID (29 of 58 rows), GA points for the 25 units in service in July 2024.

WEM: select '_ESR'/'_BESS' codes in facilities.csv; MW = System Size / 2 or max(Average MWh) x 12 from FacilitySCADA; status and dates from WA State of Energy pages; MWh only aggregated officially (WATC) for Synergy's three batteries.
if_unstructured.location_method: Use the MMS STATION street/lot address (not PO boxes) or the KCI free-text description for NEM units, GA coordinates for the 2024 fleet; for newer NEM and all WEM units only non-official points (Open Electricity, OSM) were found.
